about.title: About Promos 2015
paragraphs: Promos 2015 gathers the 25 promo cards from 16 products released in 2015: Clash of Rebellions: Special Edition, Clash of Rebellions Sneak Peek Participation Card, Crossed Souls: Advance Edition, Crossed Souls Sneak Peek Participation Card, Dimension of Chaos: Special Edition, Dimension of Chaos Sneak Peek Participation Card, Weekly Shonen Jump February 2015 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump April 2015 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump July 2015 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump October 2015 membership promotional card, Secrets of Eternity Sneak Peek Participation Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series 2015 Prize Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Volume 7 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's volume 8 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL Volume 6 promotional card and Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL Volume 7 promotional card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 25 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 26, adding the 1 other rarity).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
